mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS id, d.number AS number, d.description AS description, d.imei AS imei, d.phone AS phone, d.lastUpdate AS lastUpdate, d.enrollTime AS enrollTime, d.publicIp AS publicIp, d.custom1 AS custom1, d.custom2 AS custom2, d.custom3 AS custom3, c.name AS configName, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g.name ORDER BY g.name SEPARATOR ',') AS groupNames, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.infojson, '$.androidVersion')) AS androidVersion, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.infojson, '$.serial')) AS serial, av.version AS launcherVersion FROM devices d INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN configurations c ON d.configurationId = c.id LEFT JOIN applicationversions av ON c.mainAppId = av.id LEFT JOIN devicegroups dg ON d.id = dg.deviceId LEFT JOIN groups g ON dg.groupId = g.id LEFT JOIN userdevicegroupsaccess access ON g.id = access.groupId AND access.userId = u.id WHERE d.customerId = #{customerId} AND (u.allDevicesAvailable = TRUE OR access.id IS NOT NULL) AND ( #{configurationId} IS NULL OR #{configurationId} <= 0 OR d.configurationId = #{configurationId} ) AND ( #{filter} IS NULL OR d.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%') OR d.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%') ) AND ( #{groupId} IS NULL OR #{groupId} <= 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM devicegroups dg2 WHERE dg2.deviceId = d.id AND dg2.groupId = #{groupId} ) ) GROUP BY d.id, d.number, d.description, d.imei, d.phone, d.lastUpdate, d.enrollTime, d.publicIp, d.custom1, d.custom2, d.custom3, c.name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.infojson, '$.androidVersion')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.infojson, '$.serial')), av.version ORDER BY d.number
